acceptanceCriteria: A provider finalization receipt records and validates the immutable Contract base separately from the actual PR comparison base.
Existing receipts without the new binding retain their previous strict behavior and historical direct-merge paths remain fail-closed.
A mismatched Contract/PR base is rejected before persistence unless the explicit Contract-base binding matches, with no partial lifecycle mutation.
Focused tests cover valid differing bases, missing or wrong bindings, legacy compatibility, PR resource context, and CLI/MCP parity where applicable.
The verified fix can be used to finalize and close WI-820 without republishing v0.2.91.
goal: Make provider-bound finalization and recovery truthful when a reviewed PR compares against a later base than the immutable Contract base, while preserving backward compatibility and fail-closed validation.
intent: Separate Contract baseline identity from provider PR comparison identity in resource finalization.
outOfScope: rewriting archived WI-818 or WI-820 bytes

scenarioCoverage.expected: A provider-bound finalization receipt may record the actual reviewed PR comparison base while separately binding the immutable Contract base, and both identities remain visible and validated.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: reviewed PR compares against a later base than the Contract baseline
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused resource-finalization regression with distinct Contract and PR base revisions, then validate the persisted receipt and its close/finalize path.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A missing or incorrect Contract-base binding is rejected before any finalization receipt, close decision, or partial lifecycle state is written.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: mismatched Contract and PR bases fail closed before persistence
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run tampered receipt and wrong-binding cases and compare the repository decision and lifecycle files before and after each rejected write.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Legacy provider receipts without the new binding retain strict equality behavior, while explicit direct-merge history continues to use its narrow historical Contract-base binding and never upgrades assurance.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: legacy and historical finalization compatibility remains fail closed
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing protocol and repository compatibility tests plus new regressions for legacy PR receipts and direct-merge historical records.
